character.description: the same recurring anime protagonist in the secondhand bookshop world, with consistent face, hairstyle, outfit silhouette, age impression, and body proportions throughout the entire music video
consistency_rules: keep the same face and hairstyle across scenes
keep outfit design and color identity consistent unless the story explicitly changes them
keep age impression, body proportions, and character identity stable
do not introduce additional protagonists unless the lyrics or scene require them

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in narrow shelves to the ceiling, reading nook by the window, stacked crates outside the door; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with paper cream, leather brown, lamp amber, ink blue; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow tracking along towering shelves, close-up of aged pages and a bookmark, wide view of a cluttered shop interior; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
